interest: Contains specimen passports illustrating postwar redesign and documents controversies over SCAP restricting scholars while admitting businessmen.
overview: This file contains State Department and SCAP records from 1947 to 1949 concerning Japanese passports, travel documentation, and entry permits during the Allied Occupation. It details the transition from Imperial to redesigned postwar passports under SCAPIN 1609, the establishment of military attache procedures to manage passport extensions for Japanese nationals and Ryukyuans abroad, and correspondence addressing restrictions on American scholars seeking entry into Occupied Japan.
